character: fat male honeybee drone, amber, barrel belly, honey-smeared; white headband reading 3 КВАРТИРЫ in black capitals from frame one; six legs, front pair as arms; two thirds of frame height
cast: exactly three worker bees in white aprons and headbands, purple, teal, orange; the purple band reads ИПОТЕКА in big black capitals, the teal КРЕДИТ, the orange ДОЛГИ; the orange one carries a fat foam microphone; words flat and unbent; they work large at the lens, never talk
motion_rule: the drone is the subject of every window, his face stays deadpan all clip, the bees add to his move; no window ends in a pose; shot size never repeats
props: a fat foam microphone; spoons of honey; a jar he empties on himself; pillows bursting into feathers
environment: honeycomb bedroom at noon, direct sun, hard shadows; bed buried in white pillows

audio.delivery: flat deadpan male voice, bored, native Russian stress, unhurried
audio.pronunciation: доход is do-HOD, stress on the last syllable
audio.pacing: one phrase from 0.6 to 3.6, no breath at any join, nothing after 3.6
audio.lip_sync: jaw and lips shape every syllable, never a voice-over

timeline.a: he kicks a pillow into the lens, blanking it, honey flying off him
the orange bee swings the foam mic into the lens and shoves it under his jaw, he stares flat past it, sinking into the pillows
he throws both forelegs open across the frame, batting the mic sideways, honey ropes flying
he heaves his body off the pillows and drops it, the bed bouncing him twice, the bee chasing the mic back to his mouth, two riding the pillows
he rolls onto his back, belly wobbling the whole width, the mic following him over, his face still dead
he snatches the jar off a bee and upends it over his face, honey pouring down the mic into the lens
he hammers both forelegs into the burst pillow, punching feathers into the lens
the purple bee catches his foreleg, drops a shoulder under his belly and throws him over her back
he crashes on his back, she lands astride his chest and pins him flat, the other two pinning a foreleg each
she locks both forelegs on his throat and bares her teeth in a snarl, her face filling the frame, her ИПОТЕКА band right at the lens
his eyes bulge, he groans through the choke, his belly bucking the bed under her
his palm crashes down on the bed twice, tapping out, the mic lying in the honey by his head
his palm slides at the lens and fills the frame, honey draining through the fingers

must_appear: 3 КВАРТИРЫ on the drone band from frame one; ИПОТЕКА on the snarling bee band; КРЕДИТ and ДОЛГИ on the other two, all readable; the foam mic at his mouth all the speech; his deadpan face; the snarl; last frame is his palm filling the screen
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, static camera, cuts, a talking head, the drone motionless, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters on the bands, no other words, a blank headband, smiling, grinning, no mic while he speaks, the bees out of frame, subtitles, watermark, English speech, voice-over, the phrase repeated, any word after 3.6, deformed anatomy
